decisions.reason: The ID Vault is a recently announced feature of the super-app platform that costs little to keep on the market, and its value is still uncertain, so the option is worth holding.
The identity-bound wallet is only mentioned and overlaps with the payment framework, but it is cheap to carry while its uptake remains unresolved.
The NFC tag authenticator is a niche hardware-linked option with thin website presence, which makes it a borderline case, yet there is no clear evidence that its value has failed to materialize.
The payment and wallet framework has its own page and is a core capability of the firm's ecosystem strategy, so it should stay.
The multi-service mobile app platform is the firm's strategic super-app direction, so the commitment to it is central rather than optional.
The app shielding library has its own page, builds on the firm's long application-security expertise, and costs little to maintain.
